title: crataegus odoratissima
intro: Crataegus odoratissima, commonly known as the Fragrant Hawthorn or Odoratissima Hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a small deciduous shrub or tree that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus odoratissima include its vasodilatory, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus odoratissima include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
